name: An inhabited illustrated ending
art: The original showcase panorama is site/assets/expansion/editorial/garden-panorama.png. Create or adapt an authorized original engraving with comparable density and scene depth.

properties.label: Invitation above panoramic landscape
properties.text: Build a spacious closing section with a short large invitation at upper left, two quiet next actions at right and a panoramic landscape filling the lower half to the bottom edge.

properties.label: Editorial serif closing voice
properties.text: Use editorial serif type for the invitation and supporting navigation, keeping links as real text outside the illustration.

properties.label: Cream paper and blue ink
properties.text: Use one family of dark blue ink on cream paper, retaining cream gaps inside the drawing as structural highlights.

properties.label: Inhabited engraved panorama
properties.text: Author a connected landscape of house, trees, paths, shoreline and water with varied line density, a distinct distant layer and enough workmanship to reward close inspection.

properties.label: Static illustrated closing
properties.text: Keep the landscape still; no parallax, water motion or scroll reveal is implied by the source.

properties.label: Functional closing actions
properties.text: Keep both next actions functional and place copy feedback beside the action that caused it.

properties.label: Portrait landscape recomposition
properties.text: On portrait screens preserve a meaningful landscape crop beneath the reading area rather than shrinking the full panorama until its details disappear.

properties.label: Engraving-depth acceptance
properties.text: Review house, canopy and water at full resolution, and match line texture and depth rather than only the blue-on-cream palette.
